entities.name: Blažo Jovanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Blažo Jovanović was a Montenegrin politician and revolutionary army commander in the Yugoslav Partisans. He served as the first President of the People's Assembly of Montenegro and was also the speaker of the Parliament of the People's Republic of Montenegro from 1954 to 1963.
